# AGT-MAS-03

**Are tools, MCP servers, agent cards and protocol versions pinned and from trusted sources?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | MAS: Multi-agent and supply chain |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `connectors.protocol`, `elements.agent.tools` |

## Rule

Every tool-call and agent-to-agent connector names a protocol with its version.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI04 Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities (`owasp-asi04`)
- Model Context Protocol, specification 2026-07-28 (`mcp-spec`)
- Agent2Agent Protocol 1.0 (`a2a`)
